facts.fact: The NIA homepage says the National Identification Authority was established by the National Identification Authority Act, 2006 (Act 707) to create and maintain Ghana Cards.
The NIA homepage says L.I. 2523, the National Identity Register (Amendment) Regulations, 2026, requires identity to be authenticated biometrically against the National Identity Register.
The NIA homepage says L.I. 2523 of 2026 bars organisations from relying on photocopies or scans of the Ghana Card and makes them verify identity biometrically, with penalties for non-compliance.
